items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Pete Johnson on piano... I was the only white on the date, and this was -- well, the date was Joe Turner's, and the name of the album... is The Boss of the Blues.

ctx.x: Yes, Pete Johnson. And then everybody would get off from work. Basie had a set with the police department up there -- there were some very big cats with clubs, and no white was allowed, but I was allowed.
